title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1991-09-24
lineage: 16 bit – 48kHz DAT Master > TASCAM DA-20 (SPDIF out) -> LynxTWO-B Audio Reference Interface (SPDIF in) -> Wavelab 6.0 (Weiss Saracon for 16 BIT – 44.1kHz SRC and POWR-3 Dither)
source: Lineage: Master DAT Recording Equipment: B&K 4011 110º ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD D-10 Pro Recording Location: FOB Section BB Row 24 Seat 10

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording of the Boston Garden show, with early acoustic quirks that improve and a standout New Speedway Boogie performance.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an otherwise mediocre‑sounding Boston Garden venue but quickly clears up, delivering a crisp and well‑balanced sound. The concert shines especially in the first set’s closing New Speedway Boogie, a favorite rendition despite Jerry’s reported dislike of singing it. Overall it’s a fabulous performance presented on a solid remastered recording.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed five‑star review praises both the musical performance and the recording quality, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Starts overdriven due to Boston Garden acoustics but clears up quickly; overall crisp and well‑balanced after early issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds nicely, with the closing New Speedway Boogie highlighted as a high point; recording improves as the show progresses.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry reportedly disliked singing New Speedway Boogie, but his playing is not criticized.
